sheet.title: Begin with a square
sheet.instruction: Lay the sheet flat with an edge toward you. The four original corners will become the wing tips.
sheet.result: One square supplies both wing pairs and the body.

mark-rising-diagonal.title: Mark the rising diagonal
mark-rising-diagonal.instruction: Bring opposite corners together along the first diagonal and press the crease.
mark-rising-diagonal.result: The two halves meet in a triangle.

open-rising-diagonal.title: Open the first mark
open-rising-diagonal.instruction: Unfold the triangle along the same diagonal.

mark-falling-diagonal.title: Mark the other diagonal
mark-falling-diagonal.instruction: Bring the other pair of opposite corners together and press.
mark-falling-diagonal.result: The second triangle locates the crossing at the center.

open-falling-diagonal.title: Open the square
open-falling-diagonal.instruction: Release this fold and lay the sheet flat.
open-falling-diagonal.result: The two diagonal marks meet at the center.

blintz-the-square.title: Bring four tips to the center
blintz-the-square.instruction: Fold each corner inward until its point touches the crossing.
blintz-the-square.result: Four triangular flaps meet inside a diamond.

mark-the-back.title: Mark on the reverse
mark-the-back.instruction: Fold the four corners of the diamond behind to meet at its center.
mark-the-back.result: The smaller square has marks through both layers.

release-the-marks.title: Release the four marks
release-the-marks.instruction: Open just the four folds you made on the reverse.
release-the-marks.result: The diamond returns with four new crease lines.

open-the-blintz.title: Open the corner flaps
open-the-blintz.instruction: Unfold the original four triangles and smooth the square.
open-the-blintz.result: The marks locate the quarter lines and the pocket diagonals.

fold-the-gates.title: Fold the side gates
fold-the-gates.instruction: Bring the left and right edges inward until they meet along the middle.
fold-the-gates.result: Two loose flaps cover a tall rectangle.

pull-north-pockets.title: Pull out the far corners
pull-north-pockets.instruction: Lift the far ends of the two flaps. Spread their loose corners sideways as the far back wall folds toward the middle.
pull-north-pockets.result: A trapezoid with two free tips covers the far end.

pull-south-pockets.title: Pull out the near corners
pull-south-pockets.instruction: Open the near flaps the same way. Lower their back wall as the corners swing apart.
pull-south-pockets.result: Two boats meet at the center with four outward points.

book-the-boats.title: Close the two boats
book-the-boats.instruction: Fold the far boat behind the near one on their shared crosswise crease.
book-the-boats.result: The two trapezoids stack with the long edges together.

drop-east-hindwing.title: Lower the right hindwing
drop-east-hindwing.instruction: Swing only the near boat’s right tip down on the diagonal from the center. Leave the matching tip behind it in place.
drop-east-hindwing.result: The lower tip reaches the middle below the boat, and the right forewing stays wide.

drop-west-hindwing.title: Lower the left hindwing
drop-west-hindwing.instruction: Fold the other loose boat tip down to meet the first at the bottom.
drop-west-hindwing.result: Two broad forewings sit behind two pointed hindwings.

taper-east.title: Taper the right corner
taper-east.instruction: Turn the small outer shoulder of the right hindwing inward along its short slanting mark.
taper-east.result: The right hindwing has a narrower outside edge.

taper-west.title: Taper the left corner
taper-west.instruction: Fold the matching shoulder of the left hindwing inward.
taper-west.result: The two lower wings now have matching tapered edges.

pinch-the-body.title: Pinch the body
pinch-the-body.instruction: Bring the left and right halves together along the center. Keep the two wing pairs aligned.
pinch-the-body.result: The central book holds the two wing roots together.

spread-the-wings.title: Spread the wing pairs
spread-the-wings.instruction: Hold the narrow central pleat. Open each wing pair on its sloping root and leave a little lift.
spread-the-wings.result: Four violet wings spread around a narrow raised body.
